topic: the money priming effect — just seeing cash makes people less willing to help others
title: Just Seeing Cash Makes You Less Likely To Help Someone
description: AI-narrated commentary: psychologists found that simply being shown images of money changes how willing people are to help a stranger. #psychology #shorts #humanbehavior

hook_candidates.text: You'd think money makes you kinder — seeing it does the opposite.
Just looking at pictures of cash makes people slower to help a stranger.
Why does just seeing money make people less likely to help someone?
In one study, people saw cash-themed images — then watched a stranger drop a handful of pencils.

beats.text: You'd think money makes you kinder — seeing it does the **opposite**.
Psychologists showed people cash images, then staged a stranger dropping pencils.
Money-primed people were **slower** to help — and gave less to charity.
Next time cash crosses your mind, notice who you stop helping. Sound familiar?
